book.name: 2 Koríndshucheema
book.title: 2 Koríndshucheema Papororini kuzizimun Koríndshucheem yandarangiya tsimbunurinshtini

content: Mazinangantsa; minoo táchintspa. Apanll waana nuwaa kamachtarangiya Isusoo kamanimaama

Kirakush anoo siyaa na kamankuri, nuwaanaatsi ungirtamaam nda atina. Siyashuch tputs nuwaa chinapanda ateezi ashki, nda. Min nllitarittin tputs tamapari ashimaam zandkeezi, nda. Uwshtisin Koríndshuch nuwaa chinapanda atusin, kirakaa waanaatstin kuk nllitaritap tuyandayarusin, payupayursin, siyash kusarangana.

¿Anumashee kirak nuw mayaamaja payukuri payuchi; watam nuw ichtaru siyaa Isusoo kuk kamaniranguri mangoonarangsawa? Anoo mbizamaam pinasakina; anoo izuuru yasakina. Mishat, mangoonarangis anoo tputs ichinguru natstakanaya.

Tputs ichinguru, Paporcha Koríndshuchee kamanirangiya Isusootsi kuku, nuwaa atanaya. Ashiri yasaktamanaya. Siy Isusupaz yandamarini kiraka ashiru siy nuwaam taaksa. Apanll Wani mangimunis kirakamun yandatarich ashirangiya.

Isus waana mangeetsis yararangu, Apanlltaatiya anoo nda mbizachiya. Patumbchimuntaa yandayaruch, pastamaam taariya. Itaru, siy mangoonarangis anoo pastamaam wanindaja. Ashiruch nuw Isustana tayaspatampantana tina.
Anoo nguti teezi, nda. Isus waana nuwaa tayaspatampaneem ínarangiya. Apanll waana nuwaa yasariya. Ashimaam nuwaanitana waritareezi; pinasaktana.

Itaru, Apanll waanaatsi wizpuririni nuwaam panayaru, tayaspatampaneem nuwaa ínarangiya. Yuwamand Isus iyaam yutaritshishirini tsiparangu anumand Apanll na k'kuzee kaneesich wayarangiya. An k'kuz kaneesich taarashipancha; kizpur wanasiriya.
Itaru, k'kuz sirapuch wanimpancha. Sirútama Apanll waanaatsi kuk patumbchimun yandarangiya. Nee k'kuz nda payukus tsipatssa, tárangiya Apanlli. An k'kuz watacha sirapchiya.

Mazinangantsa; k'kuz sirapuch an yutaritamunaja; wanasirimuncha. Sirútama Apanll waana patumbchimun yandayaru, chiyaam panarangiya. Móysisarineemani panakchu, Apanll kizpur 'sineerangiya. Natumasamta Apanll 'sineemarini Móysisarinshini pshturangu, ashiru Utaáshuchsha tputs Móysisarineetsini napamaam ksimunurangitamanaya. Itaru, Apanll 'sineemarini zapshina Móysisarinshini pastarangiya. An k'kuz sirapuch wanimpaniri taarangiya.
Itaru, natsha k'kuz kaneesich, taarashipan kusarangu, ancha kizpurinasha wanasiriya; watam kamungshisheemani wayaranguwa.
Ashiriya, k'kuz sirapuch wanasirimana wanasirimuncha. Itaru, k'kuz kaneesich kizpurinashacha wanasiriya. Anoo kuk chiy mangoonkuch, Apanllsha chiyaatssha kis chinakiya.
Ancha ksumish wanasiriya. Ashirucha, na k'kuzee sirapchee yambutakpaz sheeru, anumunsha k'kuz sirapuch ndusha waritariya; pastayanlliya.
An k'kuz natumasam wanasirimshirini 'sineerangiya. Itaru, natsha k'kuz kaneesich wanasirimshirini aranginasha 'sineekiya, watam in pastamaam nduniwa. K'kuz kaneesich urutamari taachiya.
Ashiriya, in k'kuz kaneesich nda pastachu, iyaam kamungshisheemani wayarangu, ¿anoo mayaamaja nuw pazichi?

Móysisarini tamarangpari ashkeezi, nduni. Uwshacha Móysisarini yuwaa 'sineemarini tsipatanu anoo tputs pakchusin, pangtapa átu waanaatsi wach kamispat kamanirangiya, watam Apanll 'sineemarineetsini nda urutamari panaranguwa.

Ashiriya, an k'kuz sirapuch pastachu anoo ipishungarangiya; tputssha nda izuuru yasarangana. Wandaritam an k'kuz sirapuch pishumpaz ashkiya; kamis tamapari ashiru wand kámanakiya Móysisarineetsini kuku. Utaáshuch wand mangoonamaam pinasakanaya. Itaru, Isusoo mangoonkuch nda ashikchi. K'kuzee sirapcheetstaa mangoonakchi.
Itaru, Utaáshuch Isusoo ndunnaa mangoonkusin, wandaritam anoo k'kuz sirapchee nda izuuru yasachinllinaya; wand kamispapaz kámanaku ashkiya.
Itaru, Apanllee tasaskatssin, pishum ndunshaparee; ndunpaz kamis kámanaru ashchiya.
Ashirucha, atashina; Apanll Wani mangeetsich p'tseekchu, xarashish ndunshaparee; k'kuz sirapuch chiyaa ndusha wanichiya.

Ashiriya, iysha kamis ndunpaz kámanaru ashiruni, Isusoo wizpuririni izuuru yasakaniya. Isusu Apanllcha Wipa. Isusoo wanasirimshee mangoonkiniya. Ashkuni, Isus tamapari ashiru kinakaniya. Isus wanasirimshirini iyash nda pastachiya; itaru aranginasha aranginasha ashkiya. Apanll Wani uru mangeetsini ashkiya. Anumand Isusoo kuk kis kamankina.

footnotes.text: Jeremiyasa 31.31; Márkosa 14.24; 1 Koríndshucheema 11.25 tsiyatsis nipta tatsamooru taaritamta.
